subject: Consolidating manager notes + sensitive-handling playbook for biannual reviews
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: People Ops <peopleops@acmehealth.com>, Matt Jones <matt.jones@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidating manager notes + sensitive-handling playbook for biannual reviews

Hi team,

We need to consolidate manager notes and OKR updates ahead of the biannual check-ins. I attached a lightweight template to standardize input (Q2_manager_notes_template.xlsx). Goal is one consolidated packet per org by EOD next Wednesday so people ops can run the aggregate report.

Key asks:
- Please fill the "summary" tab for direct reports you manage (strengths, risks, recommended calibration band).
- Flag any sensitive cases with a short note and set the Sensitive flag column to YES.
- If you require redaction or HR-only handling, mark the "HR_hold" checkbox and include a one-line reason.

Vivek — want your read on whether managers should use a relative scale for impact or stick to the rubric this cycle.
Rishi — can you propose the calibration agenda and timing?
Evelyn — looped People Ops for guidance on redaction and evidence handling.

Thanks — aiming to keep this tight.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Eng Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_manager_notes_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating manager notes + sensitive-handling playbook for biannual reviews

Neha — thanks. Quick notes from my side:

1) Calibration timing: propose Thu Feb 25, 10:00–11:30 PT. Agenda draft attached (calibration-agenda-20270225.docx).
2) Scale: prefer sticking to the rubric (Consistent/Developing/Exceptional) this cycle to avoid shifting baselines mid-year; we can add an "impact" paragraph but keep banding stable.
3) Sensitive cases: any case that mentions PII, legal, or medical situations should be marked HR_hold. We should not include detailed medical evidence in the consolidated packet — just the one-line reason and flag.

I'll run a short pre-read and send a one-pager for managers tonight.

—Rishi

Attachment: calibration-agenda-20270225.docx (application/msword)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: People Ops <peopleops@acmehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Consolidating manager notes + sensitive-handling playbook for biannual reviews

Folks — forwarding the template and our immediate questions around redaction and evidence handling. Short summary below:

On Mon, Feb 22, 2027 at 10:18 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Neha — thanks. Quick notes from my side:
> 1) Calibration timing: propose Thu Feb 25, 10:00–11:30 PT. Agenda draft attached.
> 2) Scale: prefer sticking to the rubric (Consistent/Developing/Exceptional).
> 3) Sensitive cases: mark HR_hold for PII/legal/medical. Do not include detailed medical evidence in packet.

Ethan from People Ops — can you confirm whether we should store any evidence in the consolidated folder or route it to the HR drive? Also, are there specific redaction steps we should follow before sharing the packets with managers outside of the calibration meeting?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Eng Manager, Infra

Attachment: sensitive_flag_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)

From: People Ops <peopleops@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating manager notes + sensitive-handling playbook for biannual reviews

Hi Evelyn / Neha / Rishi,

Thanks for the ping — confirming recommended process:

- Aggregate spreadsheet (summary tabs) is fine to store in the shared team folder, provided sensitive evidence is NOT included there.
- Any supporting evidence (medical notes, legal correspondence) should be uploaded to the HR-secure drive (link below) with access only to People Ops + HR partners + the manager.
- For redaction: remove identifying PII (names of non-Redwood individuals, medical provider names) and replace with bracketed descriptors (e.g., [medical provider]).
- If you mark HR_hold, add a one-line reason and then email peopleops@acmehealth.com. We'll create a private HR packet and confirm when it's safe to include a sanitized summary in the calibration packet.

Doc storage link: https://drive.acmehealth.com/hr-secure/REVIEW-2027 (access requires Acme SSO)
Escalation: if anything has legal exposure, copy legal@acmehealth.com.

We can also run the redaction checklist for you if you prefer — reply and we'll schedule a short window.

— People Ops (Ethan)

Related links: https://drive.acmehealth.com/hr-secure/REVIEW-2027

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: People Ops <peopleops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating manager notes + sensitive-handling playbook for biannual reviews

Thanks, Ethan — that's helpful. Quick summary and action items so everyone is aligned: 

Action owners and deadlines:
- Managers: complete Q2_manager_notes_template.xlsx by EOD Monday, Mar 1. Use "Sensitive flag" + one-line reason for HR_hold items.
- Rishi: send 10-minute pre-read + calibration rubric by Tue Feb 24 COB (if you can't, ping me).
- Evelyn: coordinate with People Ops on any HR_hold cases you flagged; copy me on the ticket.
- People Ops: run redaction checklist or confirm when a private HR packet is created.

Scheduling: calibration meeting confirmed for Thu Feb 25, 10:00–11:30 PT. Invite sent.

I'll consolidate the spreadsheets into a single packet (no supporting evidence included) and drop it in the shared folder by Wed evening. If anything needs to be private, follow Ethan's guidance.

Thanks — short and focused please.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Eng Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Q2_manager_notes_template.xlsx, sensitive_flag_guidelines.pdf, calibration-agenda-20270225.docx
